script.vo01: There's an agent to guide retail cpg teams through these processes. It pulls data from The ERP and Point of sale.
script.vo02: Before, they would have needed to jump across multiple systems to manually gather insights, piecing the picture together by hand, and hoping nothing moved while they worked.
script.vo03: It reads the ERP, Point of sale, the demand forecast. It engages you in Microsoft Teams and Outlook. And it can classify customer complaints, recommends optimal resolutions and recommend optimal resolutions, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: Let's say a manager needs to classify customer complaints, recommends optimal resolutions. But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand.
script.vo05: Now, with unified data context across The ERP and Point of sale, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary.
script.vo06: It can recommend optimal resolutions in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on.
script.vo_payoff: With Returns & Complaints Resolution Agent, retail cpg teams get guided assistance embedded directly into their workflows.
script.vo_helps: The result? Work that moves faster, stays consistent, and holds the same standard every time it runs.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
